claims.text: OpenAI's model page prices GPT-5.6 Sol text tokens at $4 input / $0.40 cached / $20 output per 1M, described as 20% input and 33% output reductions.
The page states the promotional pricing holds at least through November 21, 2026.
The captured changelog and pricing pages separate this Aug 21 Sol promo from the July 30 permanent Terra/Luna reductions.
claims.context: Distinct dated entries across captured bodies.

limitations.text: Post-promo pricing and subscription-credit rollout scope are stated as time-bounded/rolling-out; not confirmed beyond the page text.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

limitations.text: The AWS reduced-pricing mirror is dated Sep 3 (post-cutoff) and was captured only as a mirror, not as W34 authority.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

targets.target: W34 timing is fixed by OpenAI's official post. Current model page confirms $4/M input and $20/M output with stated 20%/33% reductions and promotional pricing window.
targets.finding: W34 timing fixed by OpenAI's official post and current model page confirms $4/M input and $20/M output with stated reductions and promo window; base-release vs Aug 21 delta preserved.
